paper_metadata.title: Tensile properties of three newly developed Ni-base powder metallurgy superalloys

evidence.quote: Three Ni-base powder metallurgy superalloys have been developed recently, and tensile tests at temperatures ranging from room temperature (RT) to 815°C were conducted on them.
